patterns.mobile_menu_pattern: The sidebar component demonstrates mobile menu state management with isOpen boolean state and onClose callback
patterns.client_component_pattern: Use 'use client' directive at the top of files that use React hooks like useState
patterns.styling_pattern: Tailwind CSS utility classes with responsive breakpoints (md:hidden for mobile-only, hidden md:flex for desktop-only)

patterns.color_scheme: primary-600 (green) for CTAs, secondary colors for text
